resources.string: Create a room or join by code. Play with 2 or more friends, with no fixed player limit.
2+ players · 6-digit code · Free entry · No coins charged or rating changes

2 or more friends · No fixed player limit · Same questions and time · 3 or 5 rounds Free entry: no coins charged and no rating changes. Positive scores earn placement points; ties share points. Leaving forfeits the current round.
Choose 3 or 5 rounds, then confirm. Your 6-digit room code is generated only after confirmation.
Enter a 6-digit room code or a legacy 4-digit code
At least 2 online players; everyone except the host must be ready.
This round cannot be replayed after recovery. Watch the standings and wait for the next round.

Return to this room · Play again
Leave this room? During a match, you forfeit the unfinished round. Completed round points are kept.
